3: module RuboCop
4:   module Cop
5:     module Style
6:       # Checks for redundant parentheses.
7:       #
8:       # @example
9:       #
10:       #   # bad
11:       #   (x) if ((y.z).nil?)
12:       #
13:       #   # good
14:       #   x if y.z.nil?
15:       #
16:       class RedundantParentheses < Base
17:         include Parentheses
18:         include RangeHelp
19:         extend AutoCorrector
20: 
21:         ALLOWED_NODE_TYPES = %i[and or send splat kwsplat].freeze
22: 
23:         # @!method square_brackets?(node)
24:         def_node_matcher :square_brackets?, '(send {(send _recv _msg) str array hash} :[] ...)'
25: 
26:         # @!method method_node_and_args(node)
27:         def_node_matcher :method_node_and_args, '$(call _recv _msg $...)'
28: 
29:         # @!method rescue?(node)
30:         def_node_matcher :rescue?, '{^resbody ^^resbody}'
31: 
32:         # @!method allowed_pin_operator?(node)
33:         def_node_matcher :allowed_pin_operator?, '^(pin (begin !{lvar ivar cvar gvar}))'
34: 
35:         # @!method arg_in_call_with_block?(node)
36:         def_node_matcher :arg_in_call_with_block?, '^^(block (send _ _ equal?(%0) ...) ...)'
37: 
38:         def on_begin(node)
39:           return if !parentheses?(node) || parens_allowed?(node) || ignore_syntax?(node)
40: 
41:           check(node)
42:         end
43: 
44:         private
45: 
46:         def parens_allowed?(node)
47:           empty_parentheses?(node) ||
48:             first_arg_begins_with_hash_literal?(node) ||
49:             rescue?(node) ||
50:             allowed_pin_operator?(node) ||
51:             allowed_expression?(node)
52:         end
53: 
54:         def ignore_syntax?(node)
55:           return false unless (parent = node.parent)
56: 
57:           parent.while_post_type? || parent.until_post_type? || parent.match_with_lvasgn_type? ||
58:             like_method_argument_parentheses?(parent) || multiline_control_flow_statements?(node)
59:         end
60: 
61:         def allowed_expression?(node)
62:           allowed_ancestor?(node) ||
63:             allowed_method_call?(node) ||
64:             allowed_multiple_expression?(node) ||
65:             allowed_ternary?(node) ||
66:             node.parent&.range_type?
67:         end
68: 
69:         def allowed_ancestor?(node)
70:           # Don't flag `break(1)`, etc
71:           keyword_ancestor?(node) && parens_required?(node)
72:         end
73: 
74:         def allowed_method_call?(node)
75:           # Don't flag `method (arg) { }`
76:           arg_in_call_with_block?(node) && !parentheses?(node.parent)
77:         end
78: 
79:         def allowed_multiple_expression?(node)
80:           return false if node.children.one?
81: 
82:           ancestor = node.ancestors.first
83:           return false unless ancestor
84: 
85:           !ancestor.begin_type? && !ancestor.def_type? && !ancestor.block_type?
86:         end
87: 
88:         def allowed_ternary?(node)
89:           return false unless node&.parent&.if_type?
90: 
91:           node.parent.ternary? && ternary_parentheses_required?
92:         end
93: 
94:         def ternary_parentheses_required?
95:           config = @config.for_cop('Style/TernaryParentheses')
96:           allowed_styles = %w[require_parentheses require_parentheses_when_complex]
97: 
98:           config.fetch('Enabled') && allowed_styles.include?(config['EnforcedStyle'])
99:         end
100: 
101:         def like_method_argument_parentheses?(node)
102:           return false if !node.send_type? && !node.super_type? && !node.yield_type?
103: 
104:           node.arguments.one? && !node.parenthesized? &&
105:             !node.arithmetic_operation? && node.first_argument.begin_type?
106:         end
107: 
108:         def multiline_control_flow_statements?(node)
109:           return false unless (parent = node.parent)
110:           return false if parent.single_line?
111: 
112:           parent.return_type? || parent.next_type? || parent.break_type?
113:         end
114: 
115:         def empty_parentheses?(node)
116:           # Don't flag `()`
117:           node.children.empty?
118:         end
119: 
120:         def first_arg_begins_with_hash_literal?(node)
121:           # Don't flag `method ({key: value})` or `method ({key: value}.method)`
122:           hash_literal = method_chain_begins_with_hash_literal(node.children.first)
123:           if (root_method = node.each_ancestor(:send).to_a.last)
124:             parenthesized = root_method.parenthesized_call?
125:           end
126:           hash_literal && first_argument?(node) && !parentheses?(hash_literal) && !parenthesized
127:         end
128: 
129:         def method_chain_begins_with_hash_literal(node)
130:           return if node.nil?
131:           return node if node.hash_type?
132:           return unless node.send_type?
133: 
134:           method_chain_begins_with_hash_literal(node.children.first)
135:         end
136: 
137:         def check(begin_node)
138:           node = begin_node.children.first
139: 
140:           if (message = find_offense_message(begin_node, node))
141:             return offense(begin_node, message)
142:           end
143: 
144:           check_send(begin_node, node) if node.call_type?
145:         end
146: 
147:         # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
148:         def find_offense_message(begin_node, node)
149:           return 'a keyword' if keyword_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
150:           return 'a literal' if disallowed_literal?(begin_node, node)
151:           return 'a variable' if node.variable?
152:           return 'a constant' if node.const_type?
153:           if node.lambda_or_proc? && (node.braces? || node.send_node.lambda_literal?)
154:             return 'an expression'
155:           end
156:           return 'an interpolated expression' if interpolation?(begin_node)
157: 
158:           return if begin_node.chained?
159: 
160:           if node.and_type? || node.or_type?
161:             return if node.semantic_operator? && begin_node.parent
162:             return if node.multiline? && allow_in_multiline_conditions?
163:             return if ALLOWED_NODE_TYPES.include?(begin_node.parent&.type)
164:             return if begin_node.parent&.if_type? && begin_node.parent.ternary?
165: 
166:             'a logical expression'
167:           elsif node.respond_to?(:comparison_method?) && node.comparison_method?
168:             return unless begin_node.parent.nil?
169: 
170:             'a comparison expression'
171:           end
172:         end
173:         # rubocop:enable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
174: 
175:         # @!method interpolation?(node)
176:         def_node_matcher :interpolation?, '[^begin ^^dstr]'
177: 
178:         def allow_in_multiline_conditions?
179:           parentheses_around_condition_config = config.for_cop('Style/ParenthesesAroundCondition')
180:           return false unless parentheses_around_condition_config['Enabled']
181: 
182:           !!parentheses_around_condition_config['AllowInMultilineConditions']
183:         end
184: 
185:         def check_send(begin_node, node)
186:           return check_unary(begin_node, node) if node.unary_operation?
187: 
188:           return unless method_call_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
189:           return if call_chain_starts_with_int?(begin_node, node)
190: 
191:           offense(begin_node, 'a method call')
192:         end
193: 
194:         def check_unary(begin_node, node)
195:           return if begin_node.chained?
196: 
197:           node = node.children.first while suspect_unary?(node)
198: 
199:           return if node.send_type? && !method_call_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
200: 
201:           offense(begin_node, 'a unary operation')
202:         end
203: 
204:         def offense(node, msg)
205:           add_offense(node, message: "Don't use parentheses around #{msg}.") do |corrector|
206:             ParenthesesCorrector.correct(corrector, node)
207:           end
208:         end
209: 
210:         def suspect_unary?(node)
211:           node.send_type? && node.unary_operation? && !node.prefix_not?
212:         end
213: 
214:         def keyword_ancestor?(node)
215:           node.parent&.keyword?
216:         end
217: 
218:         def disallowed_literal?(begin_node, node)
219:           node.literal? && !node.range_type? && !raised_to_power_negative_numeric?(begin_node, node)
220:         end
221: 
222:         def raised_to_power_negative_numeric?(begin_node, node)
223:           return false unless node.numeric_type?
224: 
225:           next_sibling = begin_node.right_sibling
226:           return false unless next_sibling
227: 
228:           base_value = node.children.first
229: 
230:           base_value.negative? && next_sibling == :**
231:         end
232: 
233:         def keyword_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
234:           return false unless node.keyword?
235:           return true if node.special_keyword?
236: 
237:           args = *node
238: 
239:           if only_begin_arg?(args)
240:             parentheses?(args.first)
241:           else
242:             args.empty? || parentheses?(node)
243:           end
244:         end
245: 
246:         def method_call_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
247:           return false unless node.call_type?
248:           return false if node.prefix_not?
249: 
250:           send_node, args = method_node_and_args(node)
251: 
252:           args.empty? || parentheses?(send_node) || square_brackets?(send_node)
253:         end
254: 
255:         def only_begin_arg?(args)
256:           args.one? && args.first.begin_type?
257:         end
258: 
259:         def first_argument?(node)
260:           if first_send_argument?(node) ||
261:              first_super_argument?(node) ||
262:              first_yield_argument?(node)
263:             return true
264:           end
265: 
266:           node.each_ancestor.any? { |ancestor| first_argument?(ancestor) }
267:         end
268: 
269:         # @!method first_send_argument?(node)
270:         def_node_matcher :first_send_argument?, <<~PATTERN
271:           ^(send _ _ equal?(%0) ...)
272:         PATTERN
273: 
274:         # @!method first_super_argument?(node)
275:         def_node_matcher :first_super_argument?, <<~PATTERN
276:           ^(super equal?(%0) ...)
277:         PATTERN
278: 
279:         # @!method first_yield_argument?(node)
280:         def_node_matcher :first_yield_argument?, <<~PATTERN
281:           ^(yield equal?(%0) ...)
282:         PATTERN

285:         def character_adjacent_parens_required?(node)
286:           @condition_parentheses_state = {} if @condition_parentheses_state.nil?
287:           range = node.source_range
288:           source = range.source_buffer.source
289:           @condition_parentheses_state[:adjacent_source_length] = source.length
290:           /[a-z]/.match?(source[range.begin_pos - 1]) || /[a-z]/.match?(source[range.end_pos])
291:         end
292: 
293:         def cop_source_range(cop, begin_pos, end_pos)
294:           Parser::Source::Range.new(cop.processed_source.buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
295:         end
296: 
297:         def apply_parentheses_around_control_op(cop, node)
298:           @condition_parentheses_state = {}
299:           @condition_parentheses_state[:control_op_type] = node.type
300:           cond = node.condition
301:           matched = condition_parens_begin_children(cond)
302:           return unless matched
303: 
304:           first_child, rest_children = matched
305:           return if condition_parens_require_parentheses?(cop, node, first_child)
306:           return if condition_parens_semicolon_separated?(cop, first_child, rest_children)
307:           return if condition_parens_modifier_op?(first_child)
308:           return if condition_parens_allowed?(cop, cond)
309: 
310:           message = condition_parens_message(cond)
311:           cop.add_offense(cond, message: message) do |corrector|
312:             ParenthesesCorrector.correct(corrector, cond)
313:           end
314:         end
315: 
316:         def condition_parens_begin_children(cond)
317:           @condition_parentheses_state[:begin_child_count] = cond.children.size
318:           return unless cond.begin_type?
319: 
320:           children = cond.children
321:           return if children.empty?
322: 
323:           [children.first, children[1..]]
324:         end
325: 
326:         def condition_parens_require_parentheses?(cop, node, condition_body)
327:           @condition_parentheses_state[:while_or_until] = node.while_type? || node.until_type?
328:           return false if !node.while_type? && !node.until_type?
329:           return false if !condition_body.block_type? && !condition_body.numblock_type?
330: 
331:           condition_body.send_node.block_literal? && condition_body.keywords?
332:         end
333: 
334:         def condition_parens_semicolon_separated?(cop, first_exp, rest_exps)
335:           @condition_parentheses_state[:rest_expression_count] = rest_exps.size
336:           return false unless (second_exp = rest_exps.first)
337: 
338:           range = cop_source_range(cop, first_exp.source_range.end_pos, second_exp.source_range.begin_pos)
339:           range.source.include?(';')
340:         end
341: 
342:         def condition_parens_modifier_op?(node)
343:           @condition_parentheses_state[:modifier_check] = node.type
344:           return false if node.if_type? && node.ternary?
345:           return true if node.rescue_type?
346: 
347:           node.basic_conditional? && node.modifier_form?
348:         end
349: 
350:         def condition_parens_message(node)
351:           kw = node.parent.keyword
352:           @condition_parentheses_state[:condition_keyword] = kw
353:           article = kw == 'while' ? 'a' : 'an'
354:           "Don't use parentheses around the condition of #{article} `#{kw}`."
355:         end
356: 
357:         def condition_parens_allowed?(cop, node)
358:           @condition_parentheses_state[:allow_multiline] = cop.cop_config['AllowInMultilineConditions']
359:           character_adjacent_parens_required?(node) ||
360:             (cop.send(:safe_assignment?, node) && cop.send(:safe_assignment_allowed?)) ||
361:             (node.multiline? && @condition_parentheses_state[:allow_multiline])
362:         end
363: 
364:         def apply_ternary_parentheses_policy(cop, node)
365:           @condition_parentheses_state = {}
366:           condition = node.condition
367:           @condition_parentheses_state[:ternary_condition_type] = condition.type
368:           @condition_parentheses_state[:ternary_node_type] = node.type
369:           @condition_parentheses_state[:ternary_loc_line] = node.loc.line
370:           @condition_parentheses_state[:condition_loc_line] = condition.loc.line
371:           @condition_parentheses_state[:style_name] = cop.style
372:           return if ternary_only_closing_parenthesis_is_last_line?(condition)
373:           return if ternary_condition_as_parenthesized_one_line_pattern_matching?(cop, condition)
374:           return unless node.ternary? && ternary_parentheses_offense?(cop, node)
375: 
376:           message = ternary_parentheses_message(cop, node)
377:           cop.add_offense(node, message: message) do |corrector|
378:             ternary_parentheses_autocorrect(cop, corrector, node)
379:           end
380:         end
381: 
382:         def ternary_only_closing_parenthesis_is_last_line?(condition)
383:           @condition_parentheses_state[:condition_source] = condition.source
384:           condition.source.split("\n").last == ')'
385:         end
386: 
387:         def ternary_condition_as_parenthesized_one_line_pattern_matching?(cop, condition)
388:           @condition_parentheses_state[:parenthesized_call] = condition.parenthesized_call?
389:           return false unless condition.parenthesized_call?
390:           return false unless (first_child = condition.children.first)
391: 
392:           if cop.target_ruby_version >= 3.0
393:             first_child.match_pattern_p_type?
394:           else
395:             first_child.match_pattern_type?
396:           end
397:         end
398: 
399:         def ternary_parentheses_autocorrect(cop, corrector, node)
400:           condition = node.condition
401:           @condition_parentheses_state[:parenthesized_condition] = ternary_parenthesized?(condition)
402:           return nil if ternary_parenthesized?(condition) &&
403:                         (cop.send(:safe_assignment?, condition) ||
404:                          ternary_unsafe_autocorrect?(condition))
405: 
406:           if ternary_parenthesized?(condition)
407:             ternary_correct_parenthesized(cop, corrector, condition)
408:           else
409:             ternary_correct_unparenthesized(corrector, condition)
410:           end
411:         end
412: 
413:         def ternary_parentheses_offense?(cop, node)
414:           condition = node.condition
415:           @condition_parentheses_state[:safe_assignment] = cop.send(:safe_assignment?, condition)
416:           if cop.send(:safe_assignment?, condition)
417:             !cop.send(:safe_assignment_allowed?)
418:           else
419:             parens = ternary_parenthesized?(condition)
420:             case cop.style
421:             when :require_parentheses_when_complex
422:               ternary_complex_condition?(condition) ? !parens : parens
423:             else
424:               ternary_require_parentheses?(cop) ? !parens : parens
425:             end
426:           end
427:         end
428: 
429:         def ternary_complex_condition?(condition)
430:           @condition_parentheses_state[:complex_type] = condition.type
431:           if condition.begin_type?
432:             condition.to_a.any? { |child| ternary_complex_condition?(child) }
433:           else
434:             !ternary_non_complex_expression?(condition)
435:           end
436:         end
437: 
438:         def ternary_non_complex_expression?(condition)
439:           @condition_parentheses_state[:non_complex_type] = condition.type
440:           Style::TernaryParentheses::NON_COMPLEX_TYPES.include?(condition.type) ||
441:             ternary_non_complex_send?(condition)
442:         end
443: 
444:         def ternary_non_complex_send?(node)
445:           @condition_parentheses_state[:send_check] = node.type
446:           return false unless node.call_type?
447: 
448:           !node.operator_method? || node.method?(:[])
449:         end
450: 
451:         def ternary_parentheses_message(cop, node)
452:           @condition_parentheses_state[:message_style] = cop.style
453:           if ternary_require_parentheses_when_complex?(cop)
454:             command = ternary_parenthesized?(node.condition) ? 'Only use' : 'Use'
455:             format(Style::TernaryParentheses::MSG_COMPLEX, command: command)
456:           else
457:             command = ternary_require_parentheses?(cop) ? 'Use' : 'Omit'
458:             format(Style::TernaryParentheses::MSG, command: command)
459:           end
460:         end
461: 
462:         def ternary_require_parentheses?(cop)
463:           @condition_parentheses_state[:require_parentheses] = cop.style == :require_parentheses
464:           @condition_parentheses_state[:require_parentheses]
465:         end
466: 
467:         def ternary_require_parentheses_when_complex?(cop)
468:           @condition_parentheses_state[:require_when_complex] =
469:             cop.style == :require_parentheses_when_complex
470:           @condition_parentheses_state[:require_when_complex]
471:         end
472: 
473:         def ternary_parenthesized?(node)
474:           @condition_parentheses_state[:begin_type] = node.begin_type?
475:           node.begin_type?
476:         end
477: 
478:         def ternary_unsafe_autocorrect?(condition)
479:           @condition_parentheses_state[:unsafe_children] = condition.children.size
480:           condition.children.any? { |child| ternary_below_ternary_precedence?(child) }
481:         end
482: 
483:         def ternary_unparenthesized_method_call?(child)
484:           name = ternary_method_name(child)
485:           @condition_parentheses_state[:method_name] = name
486:           /^[a-z]/i.match?(name) && !child.parenthesized?
487:         end
488: 
489:         def ternary_below_ternary_precedence?(child)
490:           @condition_parentheses_state[:precedence_type] = child.type
491:           (child.or_type? && child.semantic_operator?) ||
492:             (child.and_type? && child.semantic_operator?) ||
493:             (child.send_type? && child.prefix_not?)
494:         end
495: 
496:         def ternary_method_name(node)
497:           @condition_parentheses_state[:method_name_lookup] = node.type
498:           if node.defined_type?
499:             :defined?
500:           elsif node.call_type?
501:             node.method_name
502:           end
503:         end

505:         def ternary_correct_parenthesized(cop, corrector, condition)
506:           @condition_parentheses_state[:correct_parenthesized] = true
507:           corrector.remove(condition.loc.begin)
508:           corrector.remove(condition.loc.end)
509:           corrector.insert_after(condition.loc.end, ' ') unless ternary_whitespace_after?(cop, condition)
510: 
511:           if (send_node = condition.child_nodes.last) && ternary_node_args_need_parens?(send_node)
512:             ternary_parenthesize_condition_arguments(corrector, send_node)
513:           end
514:         end
515: 
516:         def ternary_correct_unparenthesized(corrector, condition)
517:           @condition_parentheses_state[:correct_unparenthesized] = true
518:           corrector.wrap(condition, '(', ')')
519:         end
520: 
521:         def ternary_parenthesize_condition_arguments(corrector, send_node)
522:           @condition_parentheses_state[:argument_parenthesize] = send_node.type
523:           range_start = send_node.defined_type? ? send_node.loc.keyword : send_node.loc.selector
524:           opening_range = range_start.end.join(send_node.first_argument.source_range.begin)
525:           corrector.replace(opening_range, '(')
526:           corrector.insert_after(send_node.last_argument, ')')
527:         end

529:         def ternary_whitespace_after?(cop, node)
530:           last_token = cop.processed_source.last_token_of(node)
531:           @condition_parentheses_state[:space_after] = last_token.space_after?
532:           last_token.space_after?
533:         end

535:         def ternary_node_args_need_parens?(send_node)
536:           @condition_parentheses_state[:args_need_parens] = send_node.type
537:           return false unless ternary_node_with_args?(send_node)
538:           return false if send_node.arguments.none? || send_node.parenthesized?
539: 
540:           send_node.dot? || send_node.safe_navigation? ||
541:             ternary_unparenthesized_method_call?(send_node)
542:         end
543: 
544:         def ternary_node_with_args?(node)
545:           @condition_parentheses_state[:node_with_args] = node.type
546:           node.call_type? || node.defined_type?
547:         end

549:         def apply_require_call_parentheses(cop, node)
550:           @method_call_parentheses_state = {}
551:           @method_call_parentheses_state[:require_method] = node.method_name
552:           @method_call_parentheses_state[:require_parenthesized] = node.parenthesized?
553:           @method_call_parentheses_state[:require_arg_count] = node.arguments.size
554:           @method_call_parentheses_state[:require_multiline] = node.multiline?
555:           return if require_call_allowed_method_name?(cop, node.method_name)
556:           return if cop.send(:matches_allowed_pattern?, node.method_name)
557:           return if require_call_eligible_for_omission?(cop, node)
558:           return unless node.arguments? && !node.parenthesized?
559:

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Checks for redundant parentheses.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   # bad
      #   (x) if ((y.z).nil?)
      #
      #   # good
      #   x if y.z.nil?
      #
      class RedundantParentheses < Base
        include Parentheses
        include RangeHelp
        extend AutoCorrector

        ALLOWED_NODE_TYPES = %i[and or send splat kwsplat].freeze

        # @!method square_brackets?(node)
        def_node_matcher :square_brackets?, '(send {(send _recv _msg) str array hash} :[] ...)'

        # @!method method_node_and_args(node)
        def_node_matcher :method_node_and_args, '$(call _recv _msg $...)'

        # @!method rescue?(node)
        def_node_matcher :rescue?, '{^resbody ^^resbody}'

        # @!method allowed_pin_operator?(node)
        def_node_matcher :allowed_pin_operator?, '^(pin (begin !{lvar ivar cvar gvar}))'

        # @!method arg_in_call_with_block?(node)
        def_node_matcher :arg_in_call_with_block?, '^^(block (send _ _ equal?(%0) ...) ...)'

        def on_begin(node)
          return if !parentheses?(node) || parens_allowed?(node) || ignore_syntax?(node)

          check(node)
        end

        private

        def parens_allowed?(node)
          empty_parentheses?(node) ||
            first_arg_begins_with_hash_literal?(node) ||
            rescue?(node) ||
            allowed_pin_operator?(node) ||
            allowed_expression?(node)
        end

        def ignore_syntax?(node)
          return false unless (parent = node.parent)

          parent.while_post_type? || parent.until_post_type? || parent.match_with_lvasgn_type? ||
            like_method_argument_parentheses?(parent) || multiline_control_flow_statements?(node)
        end

        def allowed_expression?(node)
          allowed_ancestor?(node) ||
            allowed_method_call?(node) ||
            allowed_multiple_expression?(node) ||
            allowed_ternary?(node) ||
            node.parent&.range_type?
        end

        def allowed_ancestor?(node)
          # Don't flag `break(1)`, etc
          keyword_ancestor?(node) && parens_required?(node)
        end

        def allowed_method_call?(node)
          # Don't flag `method (arg) { }`
          arg_in_call_with_block?(node) && !parentheses?(node.parent)
        end

        def allowed_multiple_expression?(node)
          return false if node.children.one?

          ancestor = node.ancestors.first
          return false unless ancestor

          !ancestor.begin_type? && !ancestor.def_type? && !ancestor.block_type?
        end

        def allowed_ternary?(node)
          return false unless node&.parent&.if_type?

          node.parent.ternary? && ternary_parentheses_required?
        end

        def ternary_parentheses_required?
          config = @config.for_cop('Style/TernaryParentheses')
          allowed_styles = %w[require_parentheses require_parentheses_when_complex]

          config.fetch('Enabled') && allowed_styles.include?(config['EnforcedStyle'])
        end

        def like_method_argument_parentheses?(node)
          return false if !node.send_type? && !node.super_type? && !node.yield_type?

          node.arguments.one? && !node.parenthesized? &&
            !node.arithmetic_operation? && node.first_argument.begin_type?
        end

        def multiline_control_flow_statements?(node)
          return false unless (parent = node.parent)
          return false if parent.single_line?

          parent.return_type? || parent.next_type? || parent.break_type?
        end

        def empty_parentheses?(node)
          # Don't flag `()`
          node.children.empty?
        end

        def first_arg_begins_with_hash_literal?(node)
          # Don't flag `method ({key: value})` or `method ({key: value}.method)`
          hash_literal = method_chain_begins_with_hash_literal(node.children.first)
          if (root_method = node.each_ancestor(:send).to_a.last)
            parenthesized = root_method.parenthesized_call?
          end
          hash_literal && first_argument?(node) && !parentheses?(hash_literal) && !parenthesized
        end

        def method_chain_begins_with_hash_literal(node)
          return if node.nil?
          return node if node.hash_type?
          return unless node.send_type?

          method_chain_begins_with_hash_literal(node.children.first)
        end

        def check(begin_node)
          node = begin_node.children.first

          if (message = find_offense_message(begin_node, node))
            return offense(begin_node, message)
          end

          check_send(begin_node, node) if node.call_type?
        end

        # rubocop:disable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
        def find_offense_message(begin_node, node)
          return 'a keyword' if keyword_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
          return 'a literal' if disallowed_literal?(begin_node, node)
          return 'a variable' if node.variable?
          return 'a constant' if node.const_type?
          if node.lambda_or_proc? && (node.braces? || node.send_node.lambda_literal?)
            return 'an expression'
          end
          return 'an interpolated expression' if interpolation?(begin_node)

          return if begin_node.chained?

          if node.and_type? || node.or_type?
            return if node.semantic_operator? && begin_node.parent
            return if node.multiline? && allow_in_multiline_conditions?
            return if ALLOWED_NODE_TYPES.include?(begin_node.parent&.type)
            return if begin_node.parent&.if_type? && begin_node.parent.ternary?

            'a logical expression'
          elsif node.respond_to?(:comparison_method?) && node.comparison_method?

        # rubocop:enable Metrics/AbcSize, Metrics/CyclomaticComplexity, Metrics/MethodLength, Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

        # @!method interpolation?(node)
        def_node_matcher :interpolation?, '[^begin ^^dstr]'

        def allow_in_multiline_conditions?
          parentheses_around_condition_config = config.for_cop('Style/ParenthesesAroundCondition')
          return false unless parentheses_around_condition_config['Enabled']

          !!parentheses_around_condition_config['AllowInMultilineConditions']
        end

        def check_send(begin_node, node)
          return check_unary(begin_node, node) if node.unary_operation?

          return unless method_call_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
          return if call_chain_starts_with_int?(begin_node, node)

          offense(begin_node, 'a method call')
        end

        def check_unary(begin_node, node)
          return if begin_node.chained?

          node = node.children.first while suspect_unary?(node)

          return if node.send_type? && !method_call_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)

          offense(begin_node, 'a unary operation')
        end

        def offense(node, msg)
          add_offense(node, message: "Don't use parentheses around #{msg}.") do |corrector|
            ParenthesesCorrector.correct(corrector, node)
          end
        end

        def suspect_unary?(node)
          node.send_type? && node.unary_operation? && !node.prefix_not?
        end

        def keyword_ancestor?(node)
          node.parent&.keyword?
        end

        def disallowed_literal?(begin_node, node)
          node.literal? && !node.range_type? && !raised_to_power_negative_numeric?(begin_node, node)
        end

        def raised_to_power_negative_numeric?(begin_node, node)
          return false unless node.numeric_type?

          next_sibling = begin_node.right_sibling
          return false unless next_sibling

          base_value = node.children.first

          base_value.negative? && next_sibling == :**
        end

        def keyword_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
          return false unless node.keyword?
          return true if node.special_keyword?

          args = *node

          if only_begin_arg?(args)
            parentheses?(args.first)
          else
            args.empty? || parentheses?(node)
          end
        end

        def method_call_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
          return false unless node.call_type?
          return false if node.prefix_not?

          send_node, args = method_node_and_args(node)

          args.empty? || parentheses?(send_node) || square_brackets?(send_node)
        end

        def only_begin_arg?(args)
          args.one? && args.first.begin_type?
        end

        def first_argument?(node)
          if first_send_argument?(node) ||
             first_super_argument?(node) ||
             first_yield_argument?(node)
            return true
          end

          node.each_ancestor.any? { |ancestor| first_argument?(ancestor) }
        end

        # @!method first_send_argument?(node)
        def_node_matcher :first_send_argument?, <<~PATTERN
          ^(send _ _ equal?(%0) ...)
        PATTERN

        # @!method first_super_argument?(node)
        def_node_matcher :first_super_argument?, <<~PATTERN
          ^(super equal?(%0) ...)
        PATTERN

        # @!method first_yield_argument?(node)
        def_node_matcher :first_yield_argument?, <<~PATTERN
          ^(yield equal?(%0) ...)
        PATTERN


        def character_adjacent_parens_required?(node)
          @condition_parentheses_state = {} if @condition_parentheses_state.nil?
          range = node.source_range
          source = range.source_buffer.source
          @condition_parentheses_state[:adjacent_source_length] = source.length
          /[a-z]/.match?(source[range.begin_pos - 1]) || /[a-z]/.match?(source[range.end_pos])
        end

        def cop_source_range(cop, begin_pos, end_pos)
          Parser::Source::Range.new(cop.processed_source.buffer, begin_pos, end_pos)
        end

        def apply_parentheses_around_control_op(cop, node)
          @condition_parentheses_state = {}
          @condition_parentheses_state[:control_op_type] = node.type
          cond = node.condition
          matched = condition_parens_begin_children(cond)
          return unless matched

          first_child, rest_children = matched
          return if condition_parens_require_parentheses?(cop, node, first_child)
          return if condition_parens_semicolon_separated?(cop, first_child, rest_children)
          return if condition_parens_modifier_op?(first_child)
          return if condition_parens_allowed?(cop, cond)

          message = condition_parens_message(cond)
          cop.add_offense(cond, message: message) do |corrector|
            ParenthesesCorrector.correct(corrector, cond)
          end
        end

        def condition_parens_begin_children(cond)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:begin_child_count] = cond.children.size
          return unless cond.begin_type?

          children = cond.children
          return if children.empty?

          [children.first, children[1..]]
        end

        def condition_parens_require_parentheses?(cop, node, condition_body)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:while_or_until] = node.while_type? || node.until_type?
          return false if !node.while_type? && !node.until_type?
          return false if !condition_body.block_type? && !condition_body.numblock_type?

          condition_body.send_node.block_literal? && condition_body.keywords?
        end

        def condition_parens_semicolon_separated?(cop, first_exp, rest_exps)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:rest_expression_count] = rest_exps.size
          return false unless (second_exp = rest_exps.first)

          range = cop_source_range(cop, first_exp.source_range.end_pos, second_exp.source_range.begin_pos)
          range.source.include?(';')

        def condition_parens_modifier_op?(node)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:modifier_check] = node.type

          return true if node.rescue_type?

            parens = ternary_parenthesized?(condition)
            case cop.style
            when :require_parentheses_when_complex
              ternary_complex_condition?(condition) ? !parens : parens
            else
              ternary_require_parentheses?(cop) ? !parens : parens
            end
          end
        end

        def ternary_complex_condition?(condition)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:complex_type] = condition.type
          if condition.begin_type?
            condition.to_a.any? { |child| ternary_complex_condition?(child) }
          else
            !ternary_non_complex_expression?(condition)
          end
        end

        def ternary_non_complex_expression?(condition)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:non_complex_type] = condition.type
          Style::TernaryParentheses::NON_COMPLEX_TYPES.include?(condition.type) ||
            ternary_non_complex_send?(condition)
        end

        def ternary_non_complex_send?(node)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:send_check] = node.type
          return false unless node.call_type?

          !node.operator_method? || node.method?(:[])
        end

        def ternary_parentheses_message(cop, node)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:message_style] = cop.style
          if ternary_require_parentheses_when_complex?(cop)
            command = ternary_parenthesized?(node.condition) ? 'Only use' : 'Use'
            format(Style::TernaryParentheses::MSG_COMPLEX, command: command)
          else
            command = ternary_require_parentheses?(cop) ? 'Use' : 'Omit'
            format(Style::TernaryParentheses::MSG, command: command)
          end
        end

        def ternary_require_parentheses?(cop)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:require_parentheses] = cop.style == :require_parentheses
          @condition_parentheses_state[:require_parentheses]
        end

        def ternary_require_parentheses_when_complex?(cop)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:require_when_complex] =
            cop.style == :require_parentheses_when_complex
          @condition_parentheses_state[:require_when_complex]
        end

        def ternary_parenthesized?(node)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:begin_type] = node.begin_type?
          node.begin_type?
        end

        def ternary_unsafe_autocorrect?(condition)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:unsafe_children] = condition.children.size
          condition.children.any? { |child| ternary_below_ternary_precedence?(child) }
        end

        def ternary_unparenthesized_method_call?(child)
          name = ternary_method_name(child)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:method_name] = name
          /^[a-z]/i.match?(name) && !child.parenthesized?
        end

        def ternary_below_ternary_precedence?(child)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:precedence_type] = child.type
          (child.or_type? && child.semantic_operator?) ||
            (child.and_type? && child.semantic_operator?) ||
            (child.send_type? && child.prefix_not?)
        end

        def ternary_method_name(node)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:method_name_lookup] = node.type
          if node.defined_type?
            :defined?
          elsif node.call_type?
            node.method_name
          end
        end

        def ternary_correct_parenthesized(cop, corrector, condition)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:correct_parenthesized] = true
          corrector.remove(condition.loc.begin)
          corrector.remove(condition.loc.end)
          corrector.insert_after(condition.loc.end, ' ') unless ternary_whitespace_after?(cop, condition)

          if (send_node = condition.child_nodes.last) && ternary_node_args_need_parens?(send_node)
            ternary_parenthesize_condition_arguments(corrector, send_node)
          end
        end

        def ternary_correct_unparenthesized(corrector, condition)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:correct_unparenthesized] = true
          corrector.wrap(condition, '(', ')')
        end

        def ternary_parenthesize_condition_arguments(corrector, send_node)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:argument_parenthesize] = send_node.type
          range_start = send_node.defined_type? ? send_node.loc.keyword : send_node.loc.selector
          opening_range = range_start.end.join(send_node.first_argument.source_range.begin)
          corrector.replace(opening_range, '(')
          corrector.insert_after(send_node.last_argument, ')')
        end

        def ternary_whitespace_after?(cop, node)
          last_token = cop.processed_source.last_token_of(node)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:space_after] = last_token.space_after?
          last_token.space_after?
        end

        def ternary_node_args_need_parens?(send_node)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:args_need_parens] = send_node.type
          return false unless ternary_node_with_args?(send_node)
          return false if send_node.arguments.none? || send_node.parenthesized?

          send_node.dot? || send_node.safe_navigation? ||
            ternary_unparenthesized_method_call?(send_node)
        end

        def ternary_node_with_args?(node)
          @condition_parentheses_state[:node_with_args] = node.type
          node.call_type? || node.defined_type?
        end

        def apply_require_call_parentheses(cop, node)
          @method_call_parentheses_state = {}
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:require_method] = node.method_name
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:require_parenthesized] = node.parenthesized?
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:require_arg_count] = node.arguments.size
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:require_multiline] = node.multiline?
          return if require_call_allowed_method_name?(cop, node.method_name)
          return if cop.send(:matches_allowed_pattern?, node.method_name)
          return if require_call_eligible_for_omission?(cop, node)
          return unless node.arguments? && !node.parenthesized?

          cop.add_offense(node, message: 'Use parentheses for method calls with arguments.') do |corrector|
            corrector.replace(cop.send(:args_begin, node), '(')
            corrector.insert_after(cop.send(:args_end, node), ')') unless cop.send(:args_parenthesized?, node)
          end
        end

        def require_call_allowed_method_name?(cop, name)
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:allowed_method] = name
          cop.send(:allowed_method?, name) || cop.send(:matches_allowed_pattern?, name)
        end

        def require_call_eligible_for_omission?(cop, node)
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:omission_method] = node.method_name
          node.operator_method? || node.setter_method? || require_call_ignored_macro?(cop, node)
        end

        def require_call_included_macros_list(cop)
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:included_macros] =
            cop.cop_config.fetch('IncludedMacros', []).map(&:to_sym)
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:included_macros]
        end

        def require_call_ignored_macro?(cop, node)
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:ignore_macros] = cop.cop_config['IgnoreMacros']
          cop.cop_config['IgnoreMacros'] &&
            node.macro? &&
            !require_call_included_macros_list(cop).include?(node.method_name)
        end

        def apply_method_call_without_args_parentheses(cop, node)
          @method_call_parentheses_state = {}
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:bare_call_method] = node.method_name
          return unless !node.arguments? && node.parenthesized?
          return if bare_call_ineligible_node?(node)
          return if bare_call_default_argument?(node)
          return if bare_call_allowed_method_name?(cop, node.method_name)
          return if bare_call_same_name_assignment?(node)
          return if bare_call_parenthesized_it_method_in_block?(node)

          bare_call_register_offense(cop, node)
        end

        def bare_call_register_offense(cop, node)
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:bare_call_offense] = true
          cop.add_offense(bare_call_offense_range(node)) do |corrector|
            corrector.remove(node.loc.begin)
            corrector.remove(node.loc.end)
          end
        end

        def bare_call_ineligible_node?(node)
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:ineligible] = node.method_name
          node.camel_case_method? || node.implicit_call? || node.prefix_not?
        end

        def bare_call_default_argument?(node)
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:default_argument] = node.parent&.type
          node.parent&.optarg_type?
        end

        def bare_call_allowed_method_name?(cop, name)
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:bare_allowed] = name
          cop.send(:allowed_method?, name) || cop.send(:matches_allowed_pattern?, name)
        end

        def bare_call_same_name_assignment?(node)
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:assignment_method] = node.method_name
          return false if node.receiver

          bare_call_any_assignment?(node) do |asgn_node|
            next bare_call_variable_in_mass_assignment?(node.method_name, asgn_node) if asgn_node.masgn_type?

            asgn_node.loc.name.source == node.method_name.to_s
          end
        end

        def bare_call_parenthesized_it_method_in_block?(node)
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:it_method] = node.method?(:it)
          return false unless node.method?(:it)
          return false unless (block_node = node.each_ancestor(:block).first)
          return false unless block_node.arguments.empty_and_without_delimiters?

          !node.receiver && node.arguments.empty? && !node.block_literal?
        end

        def bare_call_any_assignment?(node)
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:assignment_search] = node.type
          node.each_ancestor(*AST::Node::ASSIGNMENTS).any? do |asgn_node|
            if asgn_node.shorthand_asgn?
              asgn_node, _value = *asgn_node
              next if asgn_node.send_type?
            end

            yield asgn_node
          end
        end

        def bare_call_variable_in_mass_assignment?(variable_name, node)
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:mass_assignment] = variable_name
          mlhs_node, _mrhs_node = *node
          var_nodes = *mlhs_node
          var_nodes.any? { |child| child.to_a.first == variable_name }
        end

        def bare_call_offense_range(node)
          @method_call_parentheses_state[:offense_begin] = node.loc.begin
          node.loc.begin.join(node.loc.end)
        end

        def apply_method_def_parentheses(cop, node)
          @definition_parentheses_state = {}
          @definition_parentheses_state[:def_name] = node.method_name
          return if method_def_forced_parentheses?(node)

          args = node.arguments
          if method_def_require_parentheses?(cop, args)
            if method_def_arguments_without_parentheses?(cop, node)
              method_def_missing_parentheses(cop, node)
            else
              cop.send(:correct_style_detected)
            end
          elsif cop.send(:parentheses?, args)
            method_def_unwanted_parentheses(cop, args)
          else
            cop.send(:correct_style_detected)
          end
        end

        def method_def_correct_arguments(arg_node, corrector)
          @definition_parentheses_state[:correct_arguments] = true
          corrector.replace(arg_node.loc.begin, ' ')
          corrector.remove(arg_node.loc.end)
        end

        def method_def_forced_parentheses?(node)
          @definition_parentheses_state[:endless] = node.endless?
          node.endless? || method_def_anonymous_arguments?(node)
        end

        def method_def_require_parentheses?(cop, args)
          @definition_parentheses_state[:def_style] = cop.style
          cop.style == :require_parentheses ||
            (cop.style == :require_no_parentheses_except_multiline && args.multiline?)
        end

        def method_def_arguments_without_parentheses?(cop, node)
          @definition_parentheses_state[:has_arguments] = node.arguments?
          node.arguments? && !cop.send(:parentheses?, node.arguments)
        end

        def method_def_missing_parentheses(cop, node)
          location = node.arguments.source_range
          @definition_parentheses_state[:missing_parentheses] = true
          cop.add_offense(location, message: Style::MethodDefParentheses::MSG_MISSING) do |corrector|
            cop.send(:add_parentheses, node.arguments, corrector)
            cop.send(:unexpected_style_detected, 'require_no_parentheses')
          end
        end

        def method_def_unwanted_parentheses(cop, args)
          @definition_parentheses_state[:unwanted_parentheses] = true
          cop.add_offense(args, message: Style::MethodDefParentheses::MSG_PRESENT) do |corrector|
            method_def_correct_arguments(args, corrector)
            cop.send(:unexpected_style_detected, 'require_parentheses')
          end
        end

        def method_def_anonymous_arguments?(node)
          @definition_parentheses_state[:anonymous_arguments] = node.arguments.size
          return true if node.arguments.any? do |arg|
            arg.forward_arg_type? || arg.restarg_type? || arg.kwrestarg_type?
          end
          return false unless (last_argument = node.last_argument)

          last_argument.blockarg_type? && last_argument.name.nil?
        end

        def apply_space_inside_parens(cop)
          @layout_parentheses_state = {}
          tokens = cop.processed_source.sorted_tokens
          @layout_parentheses_state[:token_count] = tokens.size
          @layout_parentheses_state[:space_style] = cop.style
          @layout_parentheses_state[:file_path] = cop.processed_source.file_path
          case cop.style
          when :space
            space_parens_process_with_space_style(cop, tokens)
          when :compact
            space_parens_process_with_compact_style(cop, tokens)
          else
            space_parens_correct_extraneous_space(cop, tokens)
          end
        end

        def space_parens_process_with_space_style(cop, tokens)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:space_style] = true
          tokens.each_cons(2) do |token1, token2|
            space_parens_correct_extraneous_space_in_empty_parens(cop, token1, token2)
            space_parens_correct_missing_space(cop, token1, token2)
          end
        end

        def space_parens_process_with_compact_style(cop, tokens)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:compact_style] = true
          tokens.each_cons(2) do |token1, token2|
            space_parens_correct_extraneous_space_in_empty_parens(cop, token1, token2)
            if !space_parens_left_parens?(token1, token2) && !space_parens_right_parens?(token1, token2)
              space_parens_correct_missing_space(cop, token1, token2)
            else
              space_parens_correct_extraneous_space_between_consecutive_parens(cop, token1, token2)
            end
          end
        end

        def space_parens_correct_extraneous_space(cop, tokens)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:extraneous_space] = true
          tokens.each_cons(2) do |token1, token2|
            next unless space_parens?(token1, token2)
            next if token2.comment?
            next unless cop.send(:same_line?, token1, token2) && token1.space_after?

            range = cop_source_range(cop, token1.end_pos, token2.begin_pos)
            cop.add_offense(range) do |corrector|
              corrector.remove(range)
            end
          end
        end

        def space_parens_correct_extraneous_space_between_consecutive_parens(cop, token1, token2)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:consecutive_parens] = true
          return if cop_source_range(cop, token1.end_pos, token2.begin_pos).source != ' '

          range = cop_source_range(cop, token1.end_pos, token2.begin_pos)
          cop.add_offense(range) do |corrector|
            corrector.remove(range)
          end
        end

        def space_parens_correct_extraneous_space_in_empty_parens(cop, token1, token2)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:empty_parens] = token1.left_parens? && token2.right_parens?
          return unless token1.left_parens? && token2.right_parens?
          return if cop_source_range(cop, token1.begin_pos, token2.end_pos).source == '()'

          range = cop_source_range(cop, token1.end_pos, token2.begin_pos)
          cop.add_offense(range) do |corrector|
            corrector.remove(range)
          end
        end

        def space_parens_correct_missing_space(cop, token1, token2)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:missing_space] = true
          return if space_parens_can_be_ignored?(cop, token1, token2)

          range = if token1.left_parens?
                    cop_source_range(cop, token2.begin_pos, token2.begin_pos + 1)
                  elsif token2.right_parens?
                    cop_source_range(cop, token2.begin_pos, token2.end_pos)
                  end
          cop.add_offense(range, message: Layout::SpaceInsideParens::MSG_SPACE) do |corrector|
            corrector.insert_before(range, ' ')
          end
        end

        def space_parens?(token1, token2)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:seen_paren_pair] = true
          token1.left_parens? || token2.right_parens?
        end

        def space_parens_left_parens?(token1, token2)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:left_pair] = true
          token1.left_parens? && token2.left_parens?
        end

        def space_parens_right_parens?(token1, token2)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:right_pair] = true
          token1.right_parens? && token2.right_parens?
        end

        def space_parens_can_be_ignored?(cop, token1, token2)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:ignore_check] = true
          return true unless space_parens?(token1, token2)
          return true if cop_source_range(cop, token1.begin_pos, token2.end_pos).source == '()'
          return true if token2.comment?

          !cop.send(:same_line?, token1, token2) || token1.space_after?
        end

        def apply_closing_parenthesis_indentation(cop, node, elements)
          @layout_parentheses_state = {}
          @layout_parentheses_state[:closing_node_type] = node.type
          if elements.empty?
            closing_parens_check_for_no_elements(cop, node)
          else
            closing_parens_check_for_elements(cop, node, elements)
          end
        end

        def closing_parens_check_for_elements(cop, node, elements)
          left_paren = node.loc.begin
          right_paren = node.loc.end
          @layout_parentheses_state[:has_right_paren] = !right_paren.nil?
          return unless right_paren && cop.send(:begins_its_line?, right_paren)

          correct_column = closing_parens_expected_column(cop, left_paren, elements)
          cop.instance_variable_set(:@column_delta, correct_column - right_paren.column)
          return if cop.instance_variable_get(:@column_delta).zero?

          message = closing_parens_message(correct_column, left_paren, right_paren)
          cop.add_offense(right_paren, message: message) do |corrector|
            cop.send(:autocorrect, corrector, right_paren)
          end
        end

        def closing_parens_check_for_no_elements(cop, node)
          left_paren = node.loc.begin
          right_paren = node.loc.end
          @layout_parentheses_state[:empty_elements] = true
          return unless right_paren && cop.send(:begins_its_line?, right_paren)

          candidates = closing_parens_correct_column_candidates(cop, node, left_paren)
          return if candidates.include?(right_paren.column)

          correct_column = candidates.first
          cop.instance_variable_set(:@column_delta, correct_column - right_paren.column)
          message = closing_parens_message(correct_column, left_paren, right_paren)
          cop.add_offense(right_paren, message: message) do |corrector|
            cop.send(:autocorrect, corrector, right_paren)
          end
        end

        def closing_parens_expected_column(cop, left_paren, elements)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:left_paren_column] = left_paren.column
          if closing_parens_line_break_after_left_paren?(left_paren, elements)
            source_indent = cop.processed_source.line_indentation(closing_parens_first_argument_line(elements))
            new_indent = source_indent - cop.send(:configured_indentation_width)
            new_indent.negative? ? 0 : new_indent
          elsif closing_parens_all_elements_aligned?(elements)
            left_paren.column
          else
            cop.processed_source.line_indentation(closing_parens_first_argument_line(elements))
          end
        end

        def closing_parens_all_elements_aligned?(elements)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:elements_count] = elements.size
          elements.flat_map do |element|
            if element.hash_type?
              element.each_child_node.map { |child| child.loc.column }
            else
              element.loc.column
            end
          end.uniq.count == 1
        end

        def closing_parens_first_argument_line(elements)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:first_argument_line] = elements.first.loc.first_line
          elements.first.loc.first_line
        end

        def closing_parens_correct_column_candidates(cop, node, left_paren)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:candidate_line] = left_paren.line
          [
            cop.processed_source.line_indentation(left_paren.line),
            left_paren.column,
            node.loc.column
          ]
        end

        def closing_parens_message(correct_column, left_paren, right_paren)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:expected_column] = correct_column
          if correct_column == left_paren.column
            Layout::ClosingParenthesisIndentation::MSG_ALIGN
          else
            format(
              Layout::ClosingParenthesisIndentation::MSG_INDENT,
              expected: correct_column,
              actual: right_paren.column
            )
          end
        end

        def closing_parens_line_break_after_left_paren?(left_paren, elements)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:line_break] = true
          elements.first && elements.first.loc.line > left_paren.line
        end

        def apply_heredoc_argument_closing_parenthesis(cop, node)
          @layout_parentheses_state = {}
          heredoc_arg = heredoc_parens_extract_heredoc_argument(node)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:heredoc_argument] = !heredoc_arg.nil?
          return unless heredoc_arg

          outermost_send = heredoc_parens_outermost_send_on_same_line(heredoc_arg)
          return unless outermost_send
          return if heredoc_parens_end_keyword_before_closing_parenthesis?(node)
          return if heredoc_parens_subsequent_closing_parentheses_in_same_line?(cop, outermost_send)
          return if heredoc_parens_exist_argument_between_heredoc_end_and_closing_parentheses?(cop, node)

          cop.add_offense(outermost_send.loc.end) do |corrector|
            heredoc_parens_autocorrect(cop, corrector, outermost_send)
          end
        end

        def heredoc_parens_autocorrect(cop, corrector, node)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:heredoc_autocorrect] = true
          heredoc_parens_fix_closing_parenthesis(cop, node, corrector)
          heredoc_parens_remove_internal_trailing_comma(cop, node, corrector) if heredoc_parens_internal_trailing_comma?(cop, node)
          heredoc_parens_fix_external_trailing_comma(cop, node, corrector) if heredoc_parens_external_trailing_comma?(cop, node)
        end

        def heredoc_parens_outermost_send_on_same_line(heredoc)
          previous = heredoc
          current = previous.parent
          @layout_parentheses_state[:heredoc_walk] = true
          until heredoc_parens_send_missing_closing_parens?(current, previous, heredoc)
            previous = current
            current = current.parent
            return unless previous && current
          end
          current
        end

        def heredoc_parens_send_missing_closing_parens?(parent, child, heredoc)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:missing_closing] = true
          parent&.call_type? &&
            parent.arguments.include?(child) &&
            parent.loc.begin &&
            parent.loc.end.line != heredoc.last_line
        end

        def heredoc_parens_extract_heredoc_argument(node)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:extract_argument] = node.arguments.size
          node.arguments.find { |arg_node| heredoc_parens_extract_heredoc(arg_node) }
        end

        def heredoc_parens_extract_heredoc(node)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:extract_heredoc_type] = node.type
          return node if heredoc_parens_heredoc_node?(node)
          return node.receiver if heredoc_parens_single_line_send_with_heredoc_receiver?(node)
          return unless node.hash_type?

          node.values.find do |value|
            heredoc = heredoc_parens_extract_heredoc(value)
            return heredoc if heredoc
          end
        end

        def heredoc_parens_heredoc_node?(node)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:heredoc_node] = true
          node.respond_to?(:heredoc?) && node.heredoc?
        end

        def heredoc_parens_single_line_send_with_heredoc_receiver?(node)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:single_line_send] = node.send_type?
          return false unless node.send_type?
          return false unless heredoc_parens_heredoc_node?(node.receiver)

          node.receiver.location.heredoc_end.end_pos > node.source_range.end_pos
        end

        def heredoc_parens_end_keyword_before_closing_parenthesis?(parenthesized_send_node)
          @layout_parentheses_state[:end_keyword_scan] = true

module RuboCop
  module Cop
    module Style
      # Checks for redundant parentheses.
      #
      # @example
      #
      #   # bad
      #   (x) if ((y.z).nil?)
      #
      #   # good
      #   x if y.z.nil?
      #
      class RedundantParentheses < Base
        include Parentheses
        extend AutoCorrector

        ALLOWED_NODE_TYPES = %i[and or send splat kwsplat].freeze

        # @!method square_brackets?(node)
        def_node_matcher :square_brackets?, '(send {(send _recv _msg) str array hash} :[] ...)'

        # @!method method_node_and_args(node)
        def_node_matcher :method_node_and_args, '$(call _recv _msg $...)'

        # @!method rescue?(node)
        def_node_matcher :rescue?, '{^resbody ^^resbody}'

        # @!method allowed_pin_operator?(node)
        def_node_matcher :allowed_pin_operator?, '^(pin (begin !{lvar ivar cvar gvar}))'

        def on_begin(node)

          check(node)
        end

        private

        def parens_allowed?(node)
          empty_parentheses?(node) ||
            first_arg_begins_with_hash_literal?(node) ||
            rescue?(node) ||
            allowed_pin_operator?(node) ||
            allowed_expression?(node)
        end

        def ignore_syntax?(node)
          return false unless (parent = node.parent)

          parent.while_post_type? || parent.until_post_type? || parent.match_with_lvasgn_type? ||
            like_method_argument_parentheses?(parent) || multiline_control_flow_statements?(node)
        end

        def allowed_expression?(node)
          allowed_ancestor?(node) ||
            allowed_multiple_expression?(node) ||
            allowed_ternary?(node) ||
            node.parent&.range_type?
        end

        def allowed_ancestor?(node)
          # Don't flag `break(1)`, etc
          keyword_ancestor?(node) && parens_required?(node)
        end

        def allowed_multiple_expression?(node)
          return false if node.children.one?

          ancestor = node.ancestors.first
          return false unless ancestor

          !ancestor.begin_type? && !ancestor.def_type? && !ancestor.block_type?
        end

        def allowed_ternary?(node)
          return false unless node&.parent&.if_type?

          node.parent.ternary? && ternary_parentheses_required?
        end

        def ternary_parentheses_required?
          config = @config.for_cop('Style/TernaryParentheses')
          allowed_styles = %w[require_parentheses require_parentheses_when_complex]

          config.fetch('Enabled') && allowed_styles.include?(config['EnforcedStyle'])
        end

        def like_method_argument_parentheses?(node)
          return false if !node.send_type? && !node.super_type? && !node.yield_type?

          node.arguments.one? && !node.parenthesized? &&

        end

        def multiline_control_flow_statements?(node)
          return false unless (parent = node.parent)
          return false if parent.single_line?

          parent.return_type? || parent.next_type? || parent.break_type?
        end

        def empty_parentheses?(node)
          # Don't flag `()`
          node.children.empty?
        end

        def first_arg_begins_with_hash_literal?(node)

        end

          node = begin_node.children.first

          if (message = find_offense_message(begin_node, node))
            return offense(begin_node, message)
          end

        end

        def find_offense_message(begin_node, node)

          return 'a literal' if disallowed_literal?(begin_node, node)
          return 'a variable' if node.variable?
          return 'a constant' if node.const_type?
          if node.lambda_or_proc? && (node.braces? || node.send_node.lambda_literal?)

          end
          return 'an interpolated expression' if interpolation?(begin_node)

            return if ALLOWED_NODE_TYPES.include?(begin_node.parent&.type)

          elsif node.respond_to?(:comparison_method?) && node.comparison_method?

          end

        def_node_matcher :interpolation?, '[^begin ^^dstr]'

        end

          return unless method_call_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)
          return if call_chain_starts_with_int?(begin_node, node) ||

        end

          node = node.children.first while suspect_unary?(node)

          return if node.send_type? && !method_call_with_redundant_parentheses?(node)

          offense(begin_node, 'a unary operation')
        end

        def offense(node, msg)
          add_offense(node, message: "Don't use parentheses around #{msg}.") do |corrector|
            ParenthesesCorrector.correct(corrector, node)
          end
        end

        def suspect_unary?(node)
          node.send_type? && node.unary_operation? && !node.prefix_not?
        end

        def keyword_ancestor?(node)
          node.parent&.keyword?
        end

        def disallowed_literal?(begin_node, node)
          node.literal? && !node.range_type? && !raised_to_power_negative_numeric?(begin_node, node)
        end

        def raised_to_power_negative_numeric?(begin_node, node)
          return false unless node.numeric_type?

          next_sibling = begin_node.right_sibling
          return false unless next_sibling

          base_value = node.children.first

          base_value.negative? && next_sibling == :**
        end

          return false unless node.keyword?
          return true if node.special_keyword?

          args = *node

          if only_begin_arg?(args)
            parentheses?(args.first)
          else
            args.empty? || parentheses?(node)
          end
        end

          return false unless node.call_type?
          return false if node.prefix_not?

          send_node, args = method_node_and_args(node)

          args.empty? || parentheses?(send_node) || square_brackets?(send_node)
        end

        def only_begin_arg?(args)
          args.one? && args.first.begin_type?
        end

          if first_send_argument?(node) ||
             first_super_argument?(node) ||
             first_yield_argument?(node)

          end

          node.each_ancestor.any? { |ancestor| first_argument?(ancestor) }
        end

        def_node_matcher :first_send_argument?, <<~PATTERN
          ^(send _ _ equal?(%0) ...)
        PATTERN

        # @!method first_super_argument?(node)
        def_node_matcher :first_super_argument?, <<~PATTERN
          ^(super equal?(%0) ...)
        PATTERN

        # @!method first_yield_argument?(node)
        def_node_matcher :first_yield_argument?, <<~PATTERN
          ^(yield equal?(%0) ...)
        PATTERN

        def call_chain_starts_with_int?(begin_node, send_node)
          recv = first_part_of_call_chain(send_node)
          recv&.int_type? && (parent = begin_node.parent) &&
            parent.send_type? && (parent.method?(:-@) || parent.method?(:+@))

          return false unless (block = node.each_descendant(:block, :numblock).first)

          block.keywords? && begin_node.each_ancestor(:send, :csend).any?
        end
      end
    end
  end

Fixed. The change in `lib/rubocop/cop/style/redundant_parentheses.rb`:

- Added `do_end_block_in_method_chain?` (redundant_parentheses.rb:1268): returns true when the parenthesized method chain contains a `do`...`end` keyword block (or a numblock written with `do`...`end`) and the parenthesized expression is an argument of a surrounding method call — removing the parens there would rebind the block to the outer call, changing semantics.
- Guarded `check_send` (redundant_parentheses.rb:188) with this check so such parentheses are no longer flagged as redundant.
